[1] The Tunisia national under-20 football team (Arabic: منتخب تونس تحت 20 سنة لكرة القدم‎ ‎ ), nicknamed "Les Aigles de Carthage (The Eagles of Carthage or The Carthage Eagles)", belongs to the Tunisian Football Federation.
[2] He was the first manager of the Tunisia national football team.
[3] The Tunisia national football team (Arabic: منتخب تونس لكرة القدم‎ ‎ ), nicknamed "Les Aigles de Carthage (The Eagles of Carthage or The Carthage Eagles)", is the national team of Tunisia and is controlled by the Tunisian Football Federation.
